{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline with NaN
trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check if the groups are comparable by severity
print("Cross-tabulation of sex and severity:")
cross_tab_sex_severity = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity'])
print(cross_tab_sex_severity)

# Compute response rate by sex
response_rate_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by sex:")
print(response_rate_by_sex)

# Compute response rate by sex and severity
response_rate_by_sex_severity = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='severity')
print("\nResponse rate by sex and severity:")
print(response_rate_by_sex_severity)

# Compute the difference in response rates by sex, stratified by severity
response_diff_by_severity = response_rate_by_sex_severity['mild'] - response_rate_by_sex_severity['mild'].iloc[0]  # F - M
print("\nDifference in response rate (F - M) by severity:")
print(response_diff_by_severity)"}
